espn-603993.headline: Ireland need a No 8 who is neither Conan nor Doris
beats: Jack Conan and Caelan Doris have held the position for over half a decade, and it has rarely happened that neither was available. Sean Jansen, who impressed on the summer tour, looks the leading candidate. Cian Prendergast has filled in at the base of the scrum before.

Paul O'Connell counted the missing leaders as two, then corrected himself: "Well, more than two". Tadhg Furlong is cleared to play, and management are "optimistic" that Sam Prendergast will be available at out-half after a wrist injury.
Ireland last played in July, conceding 40 to New Zealand. Argentina have one win this year and drew with Australia last time out. Lose this, and Ireland drop below France to fourth in the world.
Fiji are next, at home. That is a gentler place to learn a new position.

espn-603994.headline: Italy lose fifteen to injury; the Boks pick their best
beats: Italy have 15 players unavailable through injury, captain Michele Lamaro and Tommaso Menoncello among them. Tighthead Marco Riccioni is out for family reasons. Ange Capuozzo is back for the first time since the Six Nations, which is the good news.

South Africa are without Eben Etzebeth, Cheslin Kolbe, Handre Pollard and Andre Esterhuizen, and still held back their uncapped youngsters. Salmaan Moerat, one Test since 2024, takes Etzebeth's place because Erasmus wants a "grinder".
Italy conceded 47 and 57 in their last two games in July. The Boks lost their last one 38–42 in Australia, and an Italy win would drop them to 2nd, below New Zealand.
The Boks go to France six days later. Erasmus insists "All our energy is focused on the match against Italy for now." Italy will have to make that true.

espn-603995.headline: Scotland have never beaten New Zealand. Last year, nearly
beats: At Murrayfield last November, New Zealand were 17–0 up after 20 minutes, by John Kirwan's account, and won 25–17. Gregor Townsend says he never felt he could beat them as a player. As a coach he is still looking for Scotland's first win.

He looks without Jamie Ritchie, who hurt an ankle, and prop Elliot Millar Mills, who hurt a knee, both on club duty. The call-up is Ollie Blyth-Lafferty, a 20-year-old uncapped tighthead in only his second senior season.

New Zealand put 50 and 43 on Australia in October, straight after losing three in a row to South Africa. Victor Matfield thinks this could be harder for them than England at Twickenham. Win, and Scotland go above England to fifth in the world.
Kirwan says the debt New Zealand mean to settle is at Twickenham, where they lost 33–19 last year. Scotland would like to be owed one too.

espn-603996.headline: One point in it last time, one point in it now
beats: Wales won the last meeting 24–23 in Cardiff on 15 November 2025. They needed it: in July 2025 Japan had beaten them 24–19 in Kitakyushu, stretching a Welsh losing streak to 18 Tests. On the Nations Championship log, Wales are 9th and Japan 10th, separated by a single point.

Wales have not played since July, when South Africa beat them 43–0 and they failed to score a try. Japan have kept busier, putting 63 past USA in September before losing 34–28 at home to Fiji in October, a defeat in which they still scored four tries.
That gap shows up in the rankings. If Japan win, they go above Wales into 10th, and Wales slip to 12th at best.
The loser then gets no easier week. Wales host New Zealand next, and Japan go to England, neither a likely place to find a point.

espn-603997.headline: France insist the Springboks can wait
beats: South Africa come to Paris six days after this one, and Mickael Guillard says France have not discussed them. "We’re focused on Fiji," he said, which is the right answer and also the only one available.

Fiji are bottom of the twelve without a point, having let in 73 against England and 33 against Scotland in July. They have since won 34–28 in Tokyo, and ten of that side flew straight on to the Lyon camp with Jake White, appointed coach in October.
France beat Fiji 34–21 at home on 15 November 2025. Lose this one, by any margin, and they fall below England in the world rankings the week South Africa arrive.
Guillard plays alongside Jiuta Wainiqolo at club level and calls him "a phenomenon". In Lyon he gets to find out what that looks like from the other side.

espn-603998.headline: England pick their half-backs from the injury list
beats: Alex Mitchell pulled a hamstring for Northampton on Saturday, his fourth of the year. Archie McParland hurt a calf in camp. Ben Spencer, three games back from shoulder surgery, and Harry Randall are called up behind Jack van Poortvliet.
The ten is no tidier. Fin Smith has a calf strain, and Marcus Smith and George Ford are competing for a shirt that may not be vacant.

England last played on 18 July, beating Argentina 31–24. Steve Borthwick says preparation has been limited against a comparatively battle-hardened Australia. Hardened is one word for conceding 50 and 43 to New Zealand in October.
Australia lost 25–7 in England last November. Win this time and they go up to fifth, with England down to seventh. That is a lot to put on a half-back pairing assembled from whoever is left.

espn-603999.headline: A France win would put New Zealand top of the world
beats: South Africa have been ranked first since 31 August, the week they started beating New Zealand at home. Lose at Stade de France by any margin and they drop to second, behind the side they spent September beating.

The last meeting went their way: 17–32 in November 2025, with France at home. France have not played since July, when they put 42 on both Australia and Japan away. South Africa's most recent outing was a 38–42 defeat in Australia, so neither defence arrives looking airtight.

Erasmus has admitted that winning the Nations Championship is not a priority. Kieran Read thinks the experimenting could mean a struggle up north. Erasmus also calls the three Tests of this tour "three challenging matches ahead", and he is without Eben Etzebeth through injury.
Ireland in Dublin follow a week later. Not a priority, then, but a long November to lose the top spot in.

espn-604000.headline: Domingo Miotti's old team is coming to Genova
beats: Domingo Miotti played the last of his 10 Tests for Argentina on 9 July 2022. He is 30, plays fly-half for Montpellier, and is now in Italy's squad through an Italian grandfather.
He is one of four fly-halves Gonzalo Quesada has to choose from. Quesada says Miotti made his decision "despite having the opportunity to represent both countries".
Italy have lost four straight and conceded 57 and 47 in July. Argentina have one win this year but rarely lose by much: 21–27 to Australia, 10–17 to South Africa, then 28–28 with Australia.
Win and Italy go up to 9th in the world, above Fiji and Wales, a week before Fiji come to them. Argentina go on to France, where Miotti spends his weekends.

espn-604001.headline: Wales' last Test ended 43–0. This one is New Zealand
beats: Wales have not played since July, when South Africa kept them to nil and scored 43. The week before, Argentina beat them 35–21. Their way back starts against the side that put 52 on them at home on 22 November 2025.

New Zealand lost three in a row to South Africa between late August and mid-September. They answered with 50–19 and 43–21 against Australia, seven tries each time, and sit level on points with South Africa at the top of the Nations Championship.

Off the field, the URC has threatened the WRU with legal action over its talks with Premiership Rugby. On it, a Wales win would lift them above Fiji to ninth in the world. New Zealand stay second whatever happens.
Wales host Australia the following week, and New Zealand go to England. Both would prefer to arrive having scored.

sources.title: URC threaten Welsh rugby with legal action over talks with English Premiership

espn-604002.headline: England's half-backs are being picked by the physio
beats: Alex Mitchell pulled a hamstring playing for Northampton, his fourth this year. Archie McParland, 21 and uncapped, hurt a calf in camp but could still come into contention for Japan. Fin Smith has a calf problem too, with Marcus Smith and George Ford competing to cover.

Japan put 63 on the USA and 57 on Canada in September. They also conceded 56 in Australia in August and lost to Fiji in October, a side they had beaten a month earlier. England's defence will study the 56.
A Japan win would drop England to seventh, below Scotland and Australia, the week before New Zealand visit.
Jack van Poortvliet seems set to keep the nine shirt. Behind him are Ben Spencer and Harry Randall, who were not in the squad a week ago and now are.

espn-604003.headline: Fiji have nothing on the table; Ireland have third place
beats: Fiji are last of twelve without a point, 96 down on points difference, and they let in 73 against England in July. Ireland have been third in the world in every ranking table since 13 July. Anything short of a win in Dublin drops them below France.
Ireland's last outing was a 40–21 loss in New Zealand on 18 July. Fiji's was a 34–28 win away to Japan on 24 October, a month after losing there 20–15. The bottom side arrive with the fresher win.
Joey Carbery won the last of his 38 caps against Fiji in 2022. He gets another Fijian side on 20 November in Cork, at out-half for an Ireland XV against Fiji A.
Fiji then go to Italy, the only other side without a point. Ireland host South Africa, top of the table, which is reason enough to want this one quiet.

espn-604004.headline: Sixth hosts seventh, and only one keeps the seat
beats: Scotland and Australia swapped places in the rankings on 19 October. An Australian win at Murrayfield swaps them straight back.
Australia conceded 50 and 43 to New Zealand in October. Les Kiss's answer was to recall Kurtley Beale, 37, five years after his last Test.
Scotland host New Zealand eight days earlier, without Jamie Ritchie and his 63 caps after he was injured on club duty. Win this one by any margin and they go above England into fifth.
Scotland have let in 38 or more four times this year and still won two of them. Neither defence has much to lecture the other about.
